summary: Chesapeake Utilities Corporation filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement with Barclays, Citizens JMP, Ladenburg Thalmann, Morgan Stanley, RBC Capital Markets, and TD Securities as managers, forward sellers, and forward purchasers. The at-the-market program permits sales of common stock up to $225,000,000 aggregate offering price, with commissions capped at 2.0% of gross proceeds. This is an ordinary shelf takedown and forward-sale facility, not a special situation; no board recommendation, premium, or deal terms apply. Watch dilution pace and forward hedging overhang.
